order: round-robin; same inputs for both networks
preloaded: decoded BGR uint8 images in RAM; image read/PNG decode excluded
preprocessing: shared YOLOv7 square AREA-downscale, integer dimensions, gray114 letterbox, RGB float32 NCHW/255
pipeline: sequential; no overlap; no input-copy optimization
profile: separate identical 100-run pass; warmup excluded; percentages use same instrumented denominator
power: idle before and after; measured inference interval; rail scope from device tree; do not sum overlapping rails
accuracy: preserved historical evaluations only; YOLOv8 83 training/calibration images NOT comparable with YOLOv7 18 internal validation images
power_scope: VCC_SOM, INA260 U14 at 0x40; not carrier or AC wall power
background_services: unchanged; full process snapshot in results/platform.json
profile_comparison_note: Observed difference between passes, not isolated causal profiler overhead; power sampling only in normal pass.

reproduction_commands.server_analysis: python scripts/analyze.py && python scripts/figures.py && python scripts/verify_campaign.py
reproduction_commands.versions: artifacts/y7_requirements.txt for server analysis; results/platform.json for board packages
reproduction_commands.resume: run_campaign.sh skips completed passes; use a fresh campaign directory to repeat all measurements
